notes.title: Ver. 1.082 Update
notes.notes:
- Fixed some translation text errors.
- Updated Steam achievements to sync with in-game achievements.
- Added an animation for the protagonist's appearance on the Erosion Planet.
- Optimized the display of certain images.

- 修正部分翻譯文字錯誤
- 修改Steam成就會跟遊戲內成就同步
- 增加侵蝕星主角登場動畫
- 優化部分圖片顯示

notes.title: Ver. 1.073 Update
notes.notes:
- 修正回憶模式裡面有誤植的資料錯誤
- 修正成就推倒紀錄顯示錯誤
- 修正實況模式部分顯示錯誤
- 提升HMode中波奇Q體力

- Fixed data errors in the memory mode caused by typos.
- Corrected display errors in the achievement records for "Defeat."
- Resolved certain display issues in the streaming mode.
- Increased Poochi Q's stamina in H Mode.
